title: Tipsy Fruit
description: Watermelon, pineapple, and strawberries are tossed with tequila, lime juice, and agave nectar or honey for a delicious tipsy fruit side dish recipe.
ingredients: 0.25 cup silver tequila, or more to taste
0.25 cup agave nectar, or more to taste

steps.text: Combine watermelon, pineapple, and strawberries in a serving bowl.
Whisk tequila, agave nectar, lime zest, and lime juice together in a small bowl until well combined; pour over fruit and toss to coat.

video.description: Whether you’re bringing it with you onto the beach or enjoying it at home, try this fruit salad made with a twist! In this video, learn how to make tipsy fruit. This fresh and delicious fruit dish gives a bowl of diced fruit a tequila taste that’s reminiscent of a margarita. This recipe starts by dicing watermelon, pineapple, and strawberry. Next, mix together tequila, agave nectar, lime zest, and lime juice before pouring over the diced fruit.
